mira (Marketing): quick sync — need a compact benchmark playbook for webinar: show latency vs $/1M, routing impact, and two callouts for customers. keep it <1 slide.

sam (Data Science): Ill produce p50/p95 and blended cost for routing scenario. suggest visuals: 1) scatter latency vs cost, 2) small table showing routing blend numbers.

jonah (Engineering): include variants: hosted-standard, dedicated-4x, private-qlora. note: KV cache reduces effective token load by ~30% for chat workloads.

tess (Content): two short customer callouts I can use: 1) "Pick the profile that matches your SLO — trade a small latency improvement for large cost savings." 2) "Use routing + caching to maintain SLAs during spikes without 2x costs."

sam (Data Science): sample CSV for plot:
```
model,p95_ms,cost_usd_per_1M,variant
hosted,220,48,hosted
dedicated,160,28,dedicated
private-qlora,430,9,private
```

and routing blend example: start 100% hosted, when p95>250ms route 50% to dedicated -> blended cost 38. ops-bot will run the harness.

ops-bot: benchmark-run #958 initiated by sam 3  collecting traces: https://bench.redwood/958

mira (Marketing): timeline: need final numbers + copy by tomorrow noon. sam, flag any caveats (batching, context length, quantization).

sam (Data Science): will post final CSV and a 1-paragraph note: batching enabled for cost lines, disabled for p95; measured at 4k context.

jonah (Engineering): add footnote: private-qlora measured on CPU with 4-bit quant, expect higher variance under bursty traffic.

tess (Content): I'll draft slide headline: "Latency vs Token Economics: how to choose your inference profile" and two bullets from above.

mira (Marketing): awesome. once sam uploads numbers, I'll pick the visuals and drop into slide deck. thanks everyone! :rocket:
